about: Policy rule P4 time budgets (milestone 0014 Story 02.0 Task 03). budget_minutes = ceil(2 x the slowest leg's median duration / 60), from the Story 01.0 Task 01 baseline: median of the last 5 green master runs of ci.yml, recorded in docs/roadmap/0014-ci-rework-from-scratch/status.md (2026-11-12). The gate recomputes budget_minutes from median_s. A job not listed here gets default_job_minutes. A step's timeout may not exceed its job's timeout; 'steps' may set a tighter per-step budget keyed '<job>/<step id>'. Table: docs/dev/ci.md. Per-step budgets (Story 03.0 Task 01) are first estimates, not baselines (no per-step median exists yet): every one is at most its job budget, and Story 03.0 Task 04 replaces them with measured values. The 'gui' baseline is the old ci.yml 'gui-build' job's (Story 03.0 Task 03 renamed the job).

registry-prepare.source: 0012 Story 04.0 Task 03: no CI run exists yet, so median_s is an ESTIMATE (15 min), not a baseline: one cold vcpkg build of the port's four Boost ports and the repository plus the consumer, which the tag-run packaging legs already do inside the 18-minute build budget. The resulting 30 minutes is also inventory C11's job ceiling. Story 02.0's single cold run took 34 min on a developer Mac (AppleClang 14); if the first tag runs exceed 30, that is a C11 decision, not a silent raise. Replace with the median of real tag runs.
registry-prepare.ruling: Maintainer ruling 2026-11-18 (relayed in 0012 Story 04.0 Task 04): a step dominated by a cold dependency build gets 45 minutes. Evidence: the one real cold run of the registry consumer build (four Boost ports and the repository) measured 34 minutes on the developer Mac (Story 02.0; Task 03 had set 30 on an estimated 15-minute median, so the first tag run would have failed on its budget, not on a defect). The job keeps its median estimate; ruling_minutes = the 45-minute step plus the job's other steps' budgets. EXCEEDS inventory C11's 30-minute job ceiling - recorded, not silently capped. registry-prepare: checkout 3 + download 2 + prepare 45 + upload 2 = 52.

verify.source: 0012 Story 04.0 Task 04: no CI run exists yet, so median_s is an ESTIMATE, not a baseline. Per leg: checkout + dist download (~1 min), pinned tools + vcpkg bootstrap (~2 min), boost-iostreams built cold into its own prefix (DEPS), the clean-room checks (~2 min; a Visual Studio configure on Windows ~3). DEPS is scaled from the cold boost-iostreams install measured on the developer Mac (see the Task 04 doc), Windows x2 as the build job's own Windows/Linux median ratio (534/261). 2 x 14 min = 28, within inventory C11's 30-minute job ceiling. Replace with the median of real runs.
verify.ruling: Maintainer ruling 2026-11-18 (relayed in 0012 Story 04.0 Task 04): a step dominated by a cold dependency build gets 45 minutes. Evidence: the one real cold run of the registry consumer build (four Boost ports and the repository) measured 34 minutes on the developer Mac (Story 02.0; Task 03 had set 30 on an estimated 15-minute median, so the first tag run would have failed on its budget, not on a defect). The job keeps its median estimate; ruling_minutes = the 45-minute step plus the job's other steps' budgets. EXCEEDS inventory C11's 30-minute job ceiling - recorded, not silently capped. verify: its deps step builds boost-iostreams cold; checkout 2 + download 2 + deps 45 + artifact 8 = 57. The artifact step (digests, layout, consumers) stays at 8.

registry-consumer.source: 0012 Story 04.0 Task 04: nightly only, never on the PR or release path. ESTIMATE: a cold vcpkg build of the smbios-c port (four Boost ports and the whole repository) plus the consumer. Measured cold on the developer Mac: 34 min (Story 02.0) and again in Task 04 (see its doc); Windows is the slowest leg (the build job's ratio). Median estimate 30 min, so the budget is 60 min: a RECORDED EXCEPTION to inventory C11's 30-minute ceiling, for the maintainer to ratify or reject (the alternative is a non-cold, cached registry check, which P15 forbids in stage-verify.yml). Replace with the median of real nightly runs.
registry-consumer.ruling: Maintainer ruling 2026-11-18 (relayed in 0012 Story 04.0 Task 04): a step dominated by a cold dependency build gets 45 minutes. Evidence: the one real cold run of the registry consumer build (four Boost ports and the repository) measured 34 minutes on the developer Mac (Story 02.0; Task 03 had set 30 on an estimated 15-minute median, so the first tag run would have failed on its budget, not on a defect). The job keeps its median estimate; ruling_minutes = the 45-minute step plus the job's other steps' budgets. EXCEEDS inventory C11's 30-minute job ceiling - recorded, not silently capped. registry-consumer: its registry step is the same cold port build; step 45 (lowered from 57 to the ruled ceiling), job timeout 47 (checkout 2 + 45). The 2 x median formula already gives 60, so ruling_minutes does not raise it.
